title: Candlewick — chapter 4: anon_777
premise: Milo spots Ollie and says nothing
cliffhanger: Tonight the Whale put a bounty on the big screen. One thousand SOL for anon_777's real name.
nextOptions: Ollie plants a fake trail pointing at the Hill
Mrs. Pearl offers to take the blame

scenes.line: Milo saw me behind the plants. He looked right at me. He didn't say a word.
scenes.action: Milo looks straight at Ollie and says nothing

scenes.line: I rode back down in the ducks' mail sack. Nobody checks the mail.
scenes.setting: the canal down from the Hill at night
scenes.action: two ducks row Ollie home in a mail sack

scenes.line: In my town, the Board shows the ten richest wallets. Nobody from the Flats has ever been on it.
scenes.action: the Board with ten gold names

scenes.line: This morning there was a new name at number eight. anon_777.
scenes.action: anon_777 appears at number 8, everyone points, Ollie looks at his boots

scenes.line: The Flats went crazy. Someone from down here finally beat the Hill.
scenes.action: the Flats celebrate, Ollie stands still

scenes.line: I lost two trades in public. Loudly. Just in case.
scenes.action: Ollie fakes a loss, a Bot watches

scenes.line: Tonight the Whale put a bounty on the big screen. One thousand SOL for anon_777's real name.
scenes.action: the Whale posts a 1000 SOL bounty on the big screen
